`RobotoFlex-subset.ttf` derives from `/system/fonts/RobotoFlex-Regular.ttf`
in the API 35 Google APIs x86_64 Android system image. Its copyright and
SIL Open Font License are retained in `licenses/RobotoFlex-OFL.txt`.
This fixture is test data, never a bundled app font.

Generated with fontTools: subset to `Markdown Layout GPU`, preserve every
name ID and language, and retain all variable axes and glyph variations.
The `M` glyph retains 73 variation tuples, exceeding `ttf-parser`'s default
32 stack tuples and reproducing missing Mermaid labels without `gvar-alloc`.
